label: demo-live
note: Captured live during the demo video recording by the shipped CLI (`vulcan bench-concurrency --label demo-live --levels 1,8`), not by an ad-hoc client. It independently reproduces the headline scaling result: 21.8 to 157.7 aggregate chunks/s across an 8x load increase (7.23x, 90% efficiency) with median TTFT falling 4.75s to 1.423s. The separate radeon-vllm-concurrency.json run measured 7.63x on the same instance, so the effect is stable across runs and across two different clients. 'platform' records the client machine; generation ran on the Radeon GPU named in base_url.
